Current MC227 item2c, adopted MI.memo and published court OWI guidance require not previously applied to have AND HAD a first-OWI conviction set aside. Mere prior filing is not the same condition. Independent exact source-function probes reproduce refusal of a same-OWI application denied01/15/2022 and another denied OWI application.

A bounded handoff must be described as such, not as a nonexistent lifetime statutory prohibition.
